notes.title: Update 09.12.15
notes.notes:
For optimization reasons and in order to decrease waiting time for a game session to start, we have introduces several changes to the gameplay:
1. The “Dragon's Lair” arena is no longer active, its functionality has been turned off completely.
2. Bots can now be included into the game sessions.

Please, be advised that this may result in a longer waiting time for players who sign up for arena as a team. If there are not enough players online, we strongly recommend to sign up for arena not in groups, but every man for himself.
